message.title: Instabank ASA: Mandatory notification of trade by primary insider
message.body:
Janne Perlesentbakken, Deputy employee representative on the Board of Instabank, has on 4 September 2026, sold a total of 37,556 shares in Instabank ASA at a price of 4.97

See the enclosed form for further information about the transaction.

This information is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act and the EU Market Abuse Regulation (MAR).
